action.summary:
Built BANTAMTETRIS.html — a fully self-contained Tetris game in a single static HTML file (15,810 bytes, zero external references).

Features:
- 10×20 board with all 7 tetrominoes (I, J, L, O, S, T, Z) in standard colors
- 7-bag randomizer for fair piece distribution
- Rotation with wall kicks (clockwise via ↑/X, counter-clockwise via Z)
- Ghost piece showing landing position
- Hold piece (C key) with one-swap-per-piece limit
- Next piece preview
- Scoring: line clears (40/100/300/1200 × level), soft drop (+1/cell), hard drop (+2/cell)
- Level progression every 10 lines, increasing drop speed
- Pause (P), game over detection, restart via button or Enter
- Keyboard controls: ← → move, ↓ soft drop, ↑/X rotate, Z rotate ccw, Space hard drop, C hold, P pause
- Dark themed UI with gradient title, side panel with score/level/lines/next/hold/controls

Verified: JS parses and runs without errors in Node; all 22 game functions present; all 7 pieces defined; all keyboard handlers wired; no external src/href/import/fetch references; valid HTML structure with DOCTYPE and closing tags.
